headline: PGW Addresses Email Breach, Expects Minor Shipping Delays
body: PGW, a key player in automotive glass production, revealed a business email compromise incident that affected their order-entry systems. While the issue temporarily impacted the promptness of shipping notifications, all plant operations remain unaffected by encryption threats. PGW anticipates only brief delays in logistics and assures clients of minimal disruption in supply chains. The firm is working to reinforce their cybersecurity measures to prevent future incidents.
